subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` also be the TCP WebSocket and Unix HTTP-upgrade deadline, causing slower upgrades to terminate with code 1006?
rationale: The patch is bounded and well tested, but it intentionally broadens a documented control-plane call setting into transport establishment and changes behavior for legitimately slow peers.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Treat the existing operator-visible timeout as the connection and control-plane ceiling without adding another configuration surface.

options.title: Add connection timeout
options.body: Introduce a separate documented handshake timeout, accepting another compatibility-sensitive configuration field.

options.title: Preserve unbounded upgrades
options.body: Decline the behavior change and leave stalled CONNECTING transports without a transport-level deadline.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Treat the existing operator-visible timeout as the connection and control-plane ceiling without adding another configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this handle most strongly to introduction and continued ownership of the bundled Codex harness.
